name: 5-MeO-αMT
summary: A long-acting psychedelic and entactogenic tryptamine. The drug is structurally related to aMT. The drug is reported to be very potent and is sometimes sold on blotters. There have been a few reports of the drug being sold as LSD, however it seems this is rare. The drug may be an MAOI, caution is advised when dosing.
advisory: Hospitalizations have occured with as doses as low as 8mg
doseBasis: NOTE: Hospitalizations have occured with as doses as low as 8mg

pharmacology.text: 5-MeO-AMT acts as a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist, including of the serotonin 5-HT1A, 5-HT2A, and 5-HT2B receptors, among others. Its EC50 at the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor has been found to be 2 to 8.4 nM. In relation to this, it is an extremely potent agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor in vitro, showing the highest potency of any other tryptamine assessed in one study.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is sold as a recreational designer drug, sometimes on blotter paper. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它作為娛樂用設計師藥物販售，有時以吸墨紙形式出現，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它作为娱乐用设计师药物贩售，有时以吸墨纸形式出现，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include nausea, vomiting, muscle tension, a racing heart, raised blood pressure, anxiety and frightening experiences lasting many hours. It may also block monoamine oxidase, which raises the risk of serotonin syndrome, and it has been linked to deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 已知的反應包括噁心、嘔吐、肌肉緊繃、心跳急促、血壓升高、焦慮，以及持續許多小時的驚恐經驗。它也可能抑制單胺氧化酶，使血清素症候群的風險提高，並曾與死亡事件有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知的反应包括恶心、呕吐、肌肉紧绷、心跳急促、血压升高、焦虑，以及持续许多小时的惊恐经验。它也可能抑制单胺氧化酶，使血清素症候群的风险提高，并曾与死亡事件有关。

fact.en: It is one of the most potent tryptamines known, strong enough to be sold on blotter paper, a format normally used for LSD.
fact.zh: 它是已知效力最強的色胺之一，強到可以用吸墨紙（blotter）形式販售，而那種形式通常是用於LSD的。
fact.zhHans: 它是已知效力最强的色胺之一，强到可以用吸墨纸（blotter）形式贩售，而那种形式通常是用于LSD的。
